_comment: Twinned severity fixture (agni issue 1045). Read by BOTH core/results' TestSeverityTwinFixture
(over Pivot, which the check report and `check --format markdown` print) and the web tier's
findings.test.ts (over severitySections, which ranks the way the Checks panel does), so the
report and the viewer order and count findings by one set of answers rather than two.
A section is [name, count]. Sections run worst first: an unrecognized severity ahead of error
(ties by name), then error, warning, info, then `unresolved`, which holds every inconclusive

cases.name: an inconclusive finding leaves its severity
